observations.observation: Jim cycles Hexhaven Battalion for a Swamp.
observations.interpretation: Actual evidence of fixing a splash, not of Battalion's battlefield strength.
observations.ambiguity: Automatic captions; no video-frame verification. Selected sequence, not exhaustive log.

observations.observation: Bloombrute enters beside Greenhouse Propagator; Jim gains life and draws. Propagator then funds Emergency Phytomedic. A second life-gain event does not draw again.
observations.interpretation: Propagator supplies both mana and an engine trigger. Bloombrute's once-per-turn restriction matters.
observations.ambiguity: Automatic captions; no video-frame verification. Selected sequence, not exhaustive log.

observations.observation: Massacre Girl enters; Propagator triggers life gain and another Bloombrute draw.
observations.interpretation: A normal creature deployment can also replenish the hand when the engine is assembled.
observations.ambiguity: Automatic captions; no video-frame verification. Selected sequence, not exhaustive log.

observations.interpretation: Cheap support creatures can be meaningful removal targets; Cell's mana-value restriction limits its alternatives.

observations.observation: Restore with Empathy returns Emergency Phytomedic, gains four life and triggers a Bloombrute draw.
observations.interpretation: Recursion provides stabilization and additional cards in this shell; that extra draw depends on Bloombrute.
observations.ambiguity: Automatic captions; no video-frame verification. Selected sequence, not exhaustive log.

observations.observation: Jim casts Danitha before Seed Suture. Targeting draws through Danitha; resolving the spell gains life and draws through Bloombrute.
observations.interpretation: Strong, demonstrated interaction: Seed Suture adds a counter and life while triggering two draws. Requires both payoff creatures.
observations.ambiguity: Automatic captions; no video-frame verification. Selected sequence, not exhaustive log.

observations.observation: Kenji says knowledge of the lifelink ability would have changed his earlier removal choice. Jim then uses Surgical Precision's draw/life mode and draws again from Bloombrute.
observations.interpretation: Useful modal-spell synergy, but the engine's survival was influenced by unfamiliarity with the cards.

observations.observation: Kiora produces a Dragon on entry and another in response to Memory Trap. Jim attacks and the game ends in his favour.
observations.interpretation: Kiora retains value through removal. Losing this game is not evidence that Kiora is weak.

observations.observation: Marshall's two No Admittance casts remove Keeper of the Quiet Hour and Greenhouse Propagator. Each is followed by a Jace surveil; Gallia maintains pressure.
observations.interpretation: Removal also improves draw quality and helps prevent Jim establishing his engine.

observations.observation: Ajani repeatedly generates Cadets. Yoshimaru enables a fight removing Danitha; Extended Absence exiles Massacre Girl; Marshall wins after further board development.
observations.interpretation: Ajani converts a protected board into a growing threat. Removal support is part of the result.
